About us

A practical, welcoming cafe for Roy Bridge

Glen Roy Cafe is being refreshed as a village cafe, small shop, and warm, practical space for locals and visitors alike.

What we are trying to build

The goal is not to overcomplicate things. The cafe should be reliable, friendly and useful: good drinks, straightforward food, local staples, and a space that people are glad exists.

We are also hoping to offer occasional evening events, music, and community use where it feels right.

Our priorities

  • Regular opening hours
  • Good basics done consistently
  • Warm service without fuss
  • Support for locals and travellers

A friendly village cafe in Roy Bridge serving coffee, tea, baking, sandwiches and useful local staples.
